short: Total billed sales before returns and discounts.
seoTitle: Gross Sales — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: Gross sales is the total value billed to customers in a period, before deducting returns, cancellations and discounts. Gross sales flatters.
definition: Gross sales is the total value billed to customers in a period, before deducting returns, cancellations and discounts. It is the widest measure of trading activity.
bodyHtml:
Why Gross Sales matters

Gross sales flatters. A business with heavy returns or steep promotional discounting can report strong gross sales while the money actually kept is far lower.

How Gross Sales works in practice

Always publish gross and net sales together, with returns and discounts visible between them. That gap is one of the most useful diagnostics a small business has.

faq.question: Is gross sales the same as revenue?
faq.answer: Revenue usually means net sales. Gross sales is the figure before deductions.

faq.question: Should cancelled bills count in gross sales?
faq.answer: No. A cancelled bill was never a sale and should be excluded rather than netted off.
